title: Rook to the Empty File
setup: Your king is exposed on e6 with Black's queen on b7, rook on f2 and bishop on b4 all in the game.
hint: The black king is on the h-file with nothing on it. Ask what it can put there in time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rh8+}} comes down the open file and {{Qh7}} is the only block. {{Rxh7#}} removes it. Black's queen was defending everything on the queenside and could not also be on h7.
